content.title: About
content.content: Flavored non-carbonated water is pure drinking water enriched with natural flavorings such as berries, citrus or herbs. It contains no sugar, calories, or artificial sweeteners, offering a light taste without bubbles.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Flavorings are often obtained by cold-pressing or extraction to preserve aroma and nutrients.
Non‑carbonated flavored water is popular among people looking to reduce consumption of sugary drinks.
In some countries these drinks are classified as “water with additives,” not as “juice.”
Water can be fortified with vitamins and minerals, but the basic version usually contains none.
Recycled PET bottles are commonly used for packaging, lowering the environmental footprint.

items.title: Hydration without extra calories
items.content: Flavored water helps maintain fluid balance without adding sugar or calories, which is beneficial for weight management.

items.title: Supports taste preferences
items.content: Natural flavorings can encourage higher water intake for those who dislike plain water.

items.title: No artificial sweeteners
items.content: The absence of artificial sweeteners makes the drink safe for individuals sensitive to them.

items.title: Allergic reactions
items.content: Some flavorings (e.g., citrus or berries) may trigger allergies in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Acidity content
items.content: Citrus flavorings can slightly increase acidity, which may affect tooth enamel with frequent consumption.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the flavored water chilled; you can add a slice of fresh fruit or mint leaves to enhance the taste. It serves as a substitute for sugary sodas.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, it is best consumed within 3–5 days.
